# 📖 Issue Resolution Blog

This directory contains post-mortem blog posts for all resolved bugs and recurring issues.

## 📚 How to Use

1. Copy `TEMPLATE.md` to a new file: `YYYY-MM-DD-<issue-id>-<title>.md`
2. Fill in all sections (Root Cause, Fix, Prevention are mandatory)
3. Commit to a branch and open a PR
4. Run `python ../../scripts/generate-blog-index.py` to regenerate the index
